items.title: 56800_John Simmons oral history interview
items.q: He had Vic Dickenson, he had Roy and Joe Eldridge, Gus Wilson and Teddy Wilson. So that was quite a band.

ctx.x: No. He was from around Buffalo, Indianapolis. He just barnstormed, you know. But he wound up out here and he named his band that. And guess who he had in the band? He had Vic Dickenson, he had Roy and Joe Eldridge, Gus Wilson

and Teddy Wilson. And Eli Robinson and Reunald Jones, who we called Jonesy. So that was quite a band. Two brothers, sets, you know. The Wilson brothers and the Eldridge brothers. That was something else.
